desc:
💥 Welcome to Blast Soccer (BETA)!

⚽ Grab your blaster, hit the field and blast the ball into the net in fast 3v3 matches!

🎯 Blast the ball, skate at full speed, and score from anywhere!
🛹 Slide, air dash and wall ride across the arena!
🎁 Grab mystery boxes for wild abilities: missiles, boxing gloves, magnets and more!
🔫 Unlock exclusive blasters, goal explosions and ball skins!
🛒 Check the daily shop for new items every day!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for top goals and top XP!
👥 Team up with your friends and dominate the pitch!
🏅 Ranked mode coming soon! Train now and become a legend!
